system.effect:
You become Trained in this Ancestry. Use your Origin Constellation’s Proficiency Bonus for its checks. Each Talent in this Constellation contributes to your Origin Constellation’s Proficiency Rank.

You gain 8 Vigor per level. Your Speed is 6 feet. Your Size is Small. You gain the Halfling trait.

Fortunate. Once per day, after you fail or critically fail a Skill check, you may reroll it and use the second result. This does not apply to Attacks, Defenses, or Initiative.
system.description: Halflings are small, sure-handed people whose knack for finding a second chance often matters more than their size.
system.automation:
[TRAIT Halfling][SIZE Small][SPEED 6][VIGOR 8]
[EFFECT Reroll Failed or Critically Failed Skill Check; IF: CLAIM(hidden objects, concealed mechanisms, or small physical alterations)]

rules.error: EFFECT wraps an effect line, `[EFFECT <tag>: ...]`: CHECK, ATK, DEF, INIT, SPEED, IMMUNE, MARK, REROLL, IGNORE
